messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
All of this was going on in the same room.

output.original_text: All of this was going on in the same room.
output.joy: Can you believe all this amazing stuff was happening in the same room?
output.sadness: It’s hard to accept that all of this was going on in the same room, yet I felt so alone.
output.fear: All of this was happening in the same room, and I couldn’t shake the feeling that something terrible was about to occur.
output.anger: It’s infuriating that all of this was happening in the same room, and no one seemed to care!
output.surprise: Wow, I can't believe all of this was actually happening in the same room!
output.disgust: I can’t stand that all of this was going on in the same room; it was just so revolting!
